title: 合法下调的统计值在同步后反弹

history.evidence: Diff removes independently max-merged question counters and non-monotonic review/todo fields from registry and strategy. The old registry and strategy are restored exactly, preserving newer unrelated implementation.

problem_zh: 用户重置答题统计、缩短复习间隔或调低预计番茄数后，与另一设备同步会把旧的大值恢复；两端答题统计还可能组合成任何一端都没出现过的正确率。请修复冲突合并语义，同时保留真正单调计数、标签并集及布尔偏好的现有行为。
test_scope: Direct compilation of complete production Rust modules through #[path]; unrelated learner-profile dependency panics if invoked. No production function is copied.
